ValidationRule.description: Locks the Quote once Status = Approved. Users must clone to make further changes.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Approved"), NOT(ISNEW()), OR( ISCHANGED(TotalPrice), ISCHANGED(ExpirationDate), ISCHANGED(Pricebook2Id) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Approved quotes are locked. Please clone this quote to make changes.
